The '''Jendai Prophecy''' is the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s [[Karaethon Cycle|Prophecies of the Dragon]], foretelling the coming of the ''[[Coramoor]]'' and what he will do to the Sea Folk.

==Prophecies==
{{quote|The White Tower shall be broken by his name, and Aes Sedai shall kneel to wash his feet and dry them with their hair.}}

{{quote|The Stone of Tear has fallen, and war breaks over the nations of the land. Those that once ruled have returned, and have been driven back for the first time.}}

The Jendai Prophecy says the Coramoor will bring the Sea Folk glory, and all the seas of the world will be theirs.

The Jendai Prophecy, the prophecy of the Coramoor. Not the one you wait for and dread; the one we seek, herald of new Age.
